# temps_project_mcp_server (Resource)

An MCP server definition only the AI agents of one project can connect to.

Import with `<project_id>/<slug>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_mcp_server" "docs" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  slug       = "docs"
  name       = "Docs search"
  config     = jsonencode({ url = "https://mcp.example.com/sse" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Server configuration: `command` and `args` for a local server, or `url` and `headers` for a remote one. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the console.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the server.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the server provides.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<slug>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<slug>
terraform import temps_project_mcp_server.docs 8/docs
```
